Sets the stencil test and the operations for the back faces of an entity, the triangles that face away from the camera. Back faces are only drawn when the entity shows both sides ([EntityFX](EntityFX) 16). Call it after [SetEntityStencil](SetEntityStencil), which sets both sides to the same; the reference and the masks of that stay the same for both. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

The numbers of the comparison and the operations are the ones of [SetEntityStencil](SetEntityStencil). A common use is a shadow volume in one draw: the front faces increment where the depth test fails and the back faces decrement there.
@param entity  Entity handle.
@param compare  The comparison, from 0 to 7.
@param fail  The operation when the comparison fails, from 0 to 7. Default 0 (keep).
@param depth_fail  The operation when the comparison holds and the depth test fails, from 0 to 7. Default 0 (keep).
@param pass  The operation when both hold, from 0 to 7. Default 0 (keep).

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 640, 480, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
SetCameraStencil camera, True
volume = CreateCube()
EntityFX volume, 16
EntityAlpha volume, 0.01
; Front faces count up, back faces count down where the volume is behind something.
SetEntityStencil volume, 7, 0, 255, 255, 0, 6, 0
SetEntityStencilBack volume, 7, 0, 7, 0
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```
